options: солнце
солнца
солнцу
солнцем
cases.explain: Солнце is the subject of the intransitive verb сядет (will set), so it takes the nominative case.

options: паспорт
паспорта
паспорту
паспортом
cases.translation: I don't have a real passport.
cases.explain: The negated existential нет (there is no) requires the genitive case for what is absent: паспорта.

cases.sentence: Мой отец и мамаша ездили по ___ и давали представления.
options: ярмарки
ярмарок
ярмаркам
ярмарками
cases.translation: My father and mother used to travel around to fairs and give performances.
cases.explain: The preposition по (around/along) with a plural noun of routine movement governs the dative case: ярмаркам.

options: усадьба
усадьбы
усадьбу
усадьбой
cases.translation: The road to Gaev's estate can be seen.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) expressing motion toward a destination governs the accusative case: усадьбу.

options: несчастье
несчастья
несчастью
несчастьем
cases.translation: Before the misfortune, there were signs too.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case: несчастьем.

cases.sentence: Она сняла с плеч ружье и поправляет пряжку на ___.
options: ремень
ремня
ремню
ремне
cases.translation: She took the rifle off her shoulders and is adjusting the buckle on her belt.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) marking location governs the prepositional case: ремне.

reading.ru: У меня нет настоящего паспорта.
reading.question: What does Charlotte say she lacks, adding to her sense of not knowing who she is?
options: A real passport
A permanent home
Any living relatives
A proper education
reading.correct: A real passport
reading.explain: Charlotte says she has no real passport and doesn't even know her own age.

reading.ru: Когда я была маленькой девочкой, то мой отец и мамаша ездили по ярмаркам и давали представления.
reading.question: What did Charlotte's parents do for a living when she was a child?
options: They traveled to fairs giving performances
They were servants on a noble estate
They ran a small shop
They taught in a village school
reading.correct: They traveled to fairs giving performances
reading.explain: Charlotte recalls that her father and mother traveled around to fairs and put on shows.

reading.ru: Никого у меня нет.
reading.question: How does Charlotte describe her sense of isolation?
options: She has no one at all
She has too many relatives to count
She has many friends among the servants
She misses her parents but has Lopakhin
reading.correct: She has no one at all
reading.explain: Charlotte laments that she has no one — she doesn't even know who she really is.

reading.ru: Это гитара, а не мандолина.
reading.question: What does Dunyasha correct Yepikhodov about?
options: That his instrument is a guitar, not a mandolin
That he is playing the wrong song
That the guitar belongs to Yasha
That he should be working, not playing music
reading.correct: That his instrument is a guitar, not a mandolin
reading.explain: Dunyasha points out that Yepikhodov is playing a guitar, not a mandolin as he called it.

reading.ru: Я развитой человек, читаю разные замечательные книги, но никак не могу понять направление.
reading.question: What existential confusion does Yepikhodov express about his own life?
options: He can't decide whether he wants to live or shoot himself
He can't decide which book to read next
He can't decide whether to marry Dunyasha
He can't decide whether to quit his job
reading.correct: He can't decide whether he wants to live or shoot himself
reading.explain: Yepikhodov says he cannot understand what he really wants — whether to live or to shoot himself.

reading.ru: Но, тем не менее, я всегда ношу при себе револьвер.
reading.question: What does Yepikhodov reveal he always carries with him?
options: A revolver
A guitar pick
A book of poetry
A photograph of Dunyasha
reading.correct: A revolver
reading.explain: Yepikhodov states that he always carries a revolver with him, showing it to Dunyasha.

reading.ru: Я стала тревожной, все беспокоюсь.
reading.question: How does Dunyasha describe how she has changed since living among the gentry?
options: She has become anxious and worries constantly
She has become lazy and careless
She has become greedy for money
She has become bold and fearless
reading.correct: She has become anxious and worries constantly
reading.explain: Dunyasha says she has become nervous and is constantly worried, having grown too delicate for simple life.

reading.ru: Я страстно полюбила вас, вы образованный, можете обо всем рассуждать
reading.question: Why does Dunyasha say she fell in love with Yasha?
options: Because he is educated and can discuss anything
Because he gave her expensive gifts
Because he promised to marry her in Paris
Because he defended her from Yepikhodov
reading.correct: Because he is educated and can discuss anything
reading.explain: Dunyasha explains she fell passionately in love with Yasha because he is educated and can discuss any subject.

reading.ru: Надо окончательно решить, время не ждет.
reading.question: What urgent point does Lopakhin press Lyubov Andreevna and Gaev about?
options: That they must finally decide about the land, since time is running out
That they must pay Firs his wages
That they must sell the piano
That they must fix the billiard table
reading.correct: That they must finally decide about the land, since time is running out
reading.explain: Lopakhin insists the matter must be decided once and for all, since time will not wait.

reading.ru: Вчера было много денег, а сегодня совсем мало.
reading.question: What does Lyubov Andreevna notice when she looks in her purse?
options: That she had a lot of money yesterday but very little today
That her purse is missing entirely
That someone has stolen from her
That she has exactly enough for the servants' wages
reading.correct: That she had a lot of money yesterday but very little today
reading.explain: Looking into her purse, Lyubov Andreevna notices she had a lot of money yesterday but very little today.

reading.ru: Бедная моя Варя из экономии кормит всех молочным супом.
reading.question: How is Varya trying to economize according to Lyubov Andreevna?
options: By feeding everyone milk soup to save money
By selling the family's jewelry
By dismissing half the servants
By refusing to buy new clothes
reading.correct: By feeding everyone milk soup to save money
reading.explain: Lyubov Andreevna says poor Varya, to economize, feeds everyone milk soup.

reading.ru: Ваше имение собирается купить богач дириганов.
reading.question: What news does Lopakhin bring about a potential buyer for the estate?
options: A rich man named Deriganov is planning to buy it
The bank has already bought it
No one is interested in buying it
Pishchik wants to buy it
reading.correct: A rich man named Deriganov is planning to buy it
reading.explain: Lopakhin reports that the rich man Deriganov is preparing to buy the estate himself at the auction.

reading.ru: Я или зарыдаю, или закричу, или в обморок упаду.
reading.question: How does Lopakhin express his frustration with Lyubov Andreevna and Gaev's indecision?
options: He says he might burst into tears, scream, or faint
He says he will leave forever and never return
He says he will buy the estate himself immediately
He says he will call the bank to intervene
reading.correct: He says he might burst into tears, scream, or faint
reading.explain: Overwhelmed by their indecision, Lopakhin says he might cry, shout, or faint.

reading.ru: Муж мой умер от шампанского, он страшно пил.
reading.question: How does Lyubov Andreevna say her husband died?
options: From champagne — he drank terribly
In a duel
From a long illness
In an accident on the estate
reading.correct: From champagne — he drank terribly
reading.explain: Lyubov Andreevna confesses her husband died from champagne, as he drank terribly.

reading.ru: Утонул мой мальчик.
reading.question: What tragedy does Lyubov Andreevna recall happening on the river near the estate?
options: Her little boy drowned
Her husband drowned while fishing
A servant drowned trying to save a dog
Gaev nearly drowned as a child
reading.correct: Her little boy drowned
reading.explain: Lyubov Andreevna recalls that her boy drowned in the river, right there on the estate.

reading.ru: Мне предлагают место в банке.
reading.question: What job offer does Gaev mention having received?
options: A position at a bank paying six thousand a year
A teaching post at a gymnasium
A government post in Moscow
A managerial role at Lopakhin's company
reading.correct: A position at a bank paying six thousand a year
reading.explain: Gaev mentions he has been offered a post at a bank paying six thousand a year, though Lyubov Andreevna doubts he's suited for it.

reading.ru: Меня женить собирались, а вашего папаши еще на свете не было
reading.question: What does old Firs say about how long he has served the family?
options: He was already grown and about to be married before Gaev's father was even born
He was hired the same year Gaev was born
He only started working for the family five years ago
He was born into slavery on a different estate
reading.correct: He was already grown and about to be married before Gaev's father was even born
reading.explain: Firs recalls that people were already planning his marriage when Gaev's father wasn't even born yet, showing his great age and long service.

reading.ru: Наш вечный студент все с барышнями ходит
reading.question: How does Lopakhin teasingly describe Trofimov?
options: As the 'eternal student' who is always with young ladies
As a lazy servant who never works
As a foolish gambler
As a talented but poor musician
reading.correct: As the 'eternal student' who is always with young ladies
reading.explain: Lopakhin mockingly calls Trofimov 'our eternal student,' always seen walking with young ladies.

reading.ru: Надо бы только работать.
reading.question: What does Trofimov insist people should do instead of admiring themselves?
options: Simply work
Travel abroad
Study philosophy
Marry for love
reading.correct: Simply work
reading.explain: Trofimov argues that people should stop admiring themselves and instead simply work.

reading.ru: Укажите мне, где у нас ясли, о которых говорят так много и часто?
reading.question: What rhetorical challenge does Trofimov pose about Russian society's talk of progress?
options: He asks where the nurseries are that people talk about so much
He asks where the new railways are
He asks where the promised schools for peasants are
He asks where the money for reforms has gone
reading.correct: He asks where the nurseries are that people talk about so much
reading.explain: Trofimov challenges his listeners to show him the childcare nurseries that are talked about so often but never actually exist.

reading.ru: Вдруг раздается отдаленный звук, точно с неба звук лопнувшей струны, замирающий, печальный.
reading.question: What strange sound interrupts the characters' quiet conversation?
options: A distant sound like a snapped string, fading and sad, as if from the sky
The sound of a gunshot in the distance
Church bells ringing suddenly
A dog howling nearby
reading.correct: A distant sound like a snapped string, fading and sad, as if from the sky
reading.explain: The stage direction describes a mysterious distant sound resembling a snapped string, fading and mournful.

reading.ru: Перед несчастьем тоже было.
reading.question: What omen does Firs recall from before a past misfortune?
options: The same sound occurred before a past misfortune, along with an owl hooting and the samovar humming
A comet appeared in the sky
All the cattle fell ill
The well ran dry
reading.correct: The same sound occurred before a past misfortune, along with an owl hooting and the samovar humming
reading.explain: Firs recalls that before a misfortune, the same thing happened — an owl screeched and the samovar hummed constantly.

reading.ru: Позвольте вас спросить, могу ли я пройти здесь прямо на станцию?
reading.question: What does the drunken passerby ask when he appears?
options: Whether he can walk straight through to the station
Whether he can borrow money for a train ticket
Whether the family will hire him
Whether there is a tavern nearby
reading.correct: Whether he can walk straight through to the station
reading.explain: The passerby politely asks whether he may pass straight through to the station.

reading.ru: Напоминаю вам, господа, 22 августа будет продаваться вишневый сад.
reading.question: What reminder does Lopakhin give the group as they head off to supper?
options: That the cherry orchard will be sold on August 22nd
That the musicians have been paid
That Varya's engagement will be announced soon
That the train to Kharkov leaves at dawn
reading.correct: That the cherry orchard will be sold on August 22nd
reading.explain: Lopakhin reminds everyone that the cherry orchard will go up for sale on August 22nd, urging them to think about it.

reading.ru: Если у вас есть ключи от хозяйства, то бросьте их в колодец и уходите.
reading.question: What radical advice does Trofimov give Anya about the estate?
options: To throw the household keys into the well and leave
To sell the keys to Lopakhin
To give the keys to Varya permanently
To lock up the house and never return
reading.correct: To throw the household keys into the well and leave
reading.explain: Trofimov tells Anya that if she has the keys to the household, she should throw them into the well and walk away, to be free.
